notes: Merged from the two former command-runner skills (lint/type-check and suite execution). Fires to execute a project's existing quality commands: lint/type-check/light static analysis after code changes, and the test suite on demand. Two overlaps are handled by the description rather than a second boundary eval: deep code-level security auditing (OWASP, injection, secrets, attack surface) belongs to vulnerability-scanner — this skill only runs a light dependency audit like npm audit — and test strategy questions belong to testing-strategy. The boundary eval covers the nearest-neighbor confusion: authoring test cases.

evals.prompt: I just finished my code changes. Run lint and type checks and make sure everything's clean before I call it done.
evals.expected_output: Detects the stack from PROJECT.md/CLAUDE.md or detect_stack.sh, runs the lint/fix and type-check commands (e.g. eslint --fix + tsc --noEmit) plus a light dependency audit, analyzes the report, and loops fixing issues until all checks pass before reporting done. If no linter is configured, checks for config files and suggests creating one.

evals.prompt: Run the full test suite and tell me whether everything passes.
evals.expected_output: Detects test commands from PROJECT.md, type-checks first as a gate, runs the backend and frontend suites with coverage, emits the Test Run Result table (totals/passed/failed/coverage/status), checks the quality gates, and on failure routes to fix-bug with the failing test name and error. Does not author new tests.

evals.prompt: Write test cases for the payment module.
evals.expected_output: Should route to unit-test (or integration-test), not fire, because validate-and-test only executes existing checks and suites — authoring test cases is NOT FOR this skill.
